description: The glossary search (⌘K on macOS, Ctrl+K elsewhere): a modal dialog listing every name Baude knows for the open chat's folder and every chat, searched as you type. It's the same list the @ picker uses in the composer and Meta.
opens: key ⌘K / Ctrl+K, from anywhere in the window

parts.name: dialog
parts.shows: An Adw dialog titled "Glossary", about 760 wide by 520 tall.

parts.name: search field
parts.shows: A search entry at the top with placeholder "Search", focused when the dialog shows.

actions.does: filters as you type: each word you type must match, in any order, best match first; matched text is highlighted in the rows

actions.by: key Down / Up (Page Down / Page Up: ten rows)
actions.does: moves the picked row while you type

parts.name: table
parts.shows: No header. Three columns, the first and last stretching, the middle fixed: Name (the logo its links have, then the name, middle-ellipsised, highlighted where it matched), Kind (dim: e.g. File, Commit, Branch, Pull request, Issue, Env var, Constant, Code symbol, Config key, Service, Kubernetes object, Package, Command, External tool, Tool, Subagent type, Skill, HTTP route, Kubeconfig cluster/context, Database, Database table, Chat), Where (dim: the file or place, or for a pull request or issue its state and number). At most 400 rows are shown. Fainter rows are older or less certain. Tooltips carry the full text for long cells, and a "time ago" for rows that have one. Columns can be resized.

actions.does: closes the dialog and opens that name

parts.name: what opening does
parts.shows: A name a reply looked up opens as its link does (see Signal links). A catalogued name no reply has looked up: a running workload or a Kubernetes context opens in the Kubernetes view filtered to it; a manifest's object or a file opens at its file in a code tab (several files of that name: a toast "<n> files are called <name>"); a branch opens on the Git page; a database table opens in its database's diagram; a database opens the schema view; a pull request or issue opens on GitHub (one of Baude's own feedback issues on the Feedback tab). A chat opens as the sidebar opens it (the open chat: its tab is shown; another host's chat is fetched). A file or manifest object on another host is read from that host and shown in a tab; anything else on another host gets a toast "<name>: <kind> on <host>".

parts.name: footer
parts.shows: At the left, working dots while more names are still coming in (the catalogue is made afresh if it's old, and the table fills in as parts arrive); at the right, a dim caption "<matched> out of <total>".

states.name: building
states.shows: Dots at bottom left; rows appear and the count grows as the catalogue comes in; the picked row stays picked if still there

states.name: Signal off
states.shows: Still works: the catalogue (files, branches, Kubernetes objects and contexts, running workloads, database tables) is listed with Signal off too

states.name: chat on another host
states.shows: That host's folder names are made on it and listed as they come; other hosts' chats are listed after this host's
